info.title: EventFlow Delivery API
info.description: JWT bearer authentication required. Tenant comes from tenant_id; producer ownership comes from sub. Cross-tenant resources return 404. See docs/security/authentication.md.

default.description: Error; malformed input 400, missing entity 404, conflict 409, admission limit 429, infrastructure failure 5xx.

401.description: Missing or invalid JWT (signature, issuer, audience, lifetime, tenant or subject).

403.description: Valid token lacks the role required for this operation.

404.description: Entity is absent, outside this tenant, or owned by another producer.

get.description: PRODUCER may read its own events; VIEWER, DLQ_OPERATOR and ADMIN may read events in their tenant.

post.summary: Reset one DEAD delivery job; stable eventId, new bounded attempt budget; no bulk replay
